summary: Wave Nano 1.45B in a plain chat format, for questions about industrial telemetry, equipment and plant systems.
best_at: Conversation about industrial telemetry and equipment, SQL, and short technical writing.
not_for: General knowledge and trivia: it is weak there at this size.

summary: Fire-site decision model, not a chat model. Takes one fire controller tick (a JSON sensor block) and returns one JSON alert decision.
best_at: Specialized: only ticks in the controller's prompt format. On 1,200 recorded ticks from one site, read 2026-11-20: no missed alarms, persistent smoke 100%, 97.1% across tick types.
not_for: Chat or free text, which get a usage note. Decision support only: not a listed fire alarm, not a substitute for emergency services. In a fire, call your local emergency number.

summary: Specialized smoke check, not a chat model. Takes one camera image with one fixed question and answers yes or no.
best_at: Confirming or ruling out smoke in one frame or a detector's crop. On 1,129 held-out frames from the camera network it learned on, read 2026-11-20: AUC 0.969, finds 93.7% of smoke frames.
not_for: Chat, video, acting alone, or cameras unlike the ones it learned on. Decision support only: not a listed fire alarm or emergency services. See the license note before commercial use.

summary: Wave Pico 293M. Reads one industrial telemetry channel and names the instrument fault or the process state.
best_at: One channel at a time from Modbus, Sparkplug B, Prometheus, InfluxDB, Datadog or syslog. Answers only above a measured confidence gate and escalates below it.
not_for: Root-cause chains, which it reads at chance. Process state is its weakest family.
